paragraphs.text: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman arrayed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars;
paragraphs.original: Καὶ σημεῖον μέγα ὤφθη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, γυνὴ περιβεβλημένη τὸν ἥλιον, καὶ ἡ σελήνη ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτῆς στέφανος ἀστέρων δώδεκα,
paragraphs.translit: Kai sēmeion mega ōphthē en tō ouranō, gynē peribeblēmenē ton hēlion, kai hē selēnē hypokatō tōn podōn autēs, kai epi tēs kephalēs autēs stephanos asterōn dōdeka,

paragraphs.text: and she was the child; and she crieth out, travailing in birth, and in pain to be delivered.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα· καὶ κράζει ὠδίνουσα καὶ βασανιζομένη τεκεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: kai en gastri echousa· kai krazei ōdinousa kai basanizomenē tekein.

paragraphs.text: And there was seen another sign in heaven: and behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὤφθη ἄλλο σημεῖον ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἰδοὺ δράκων μέγας πυρρός, ἔχων κεφαλὰς ἑπτὰ καὶ κέρατα δέκα καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτοῦ ἑπτὰ διαδήματα,
paragraphs.translit: kai ōphthē allo sēmeion en tō ouranō, kai idou drakōn megas pyrros, echōn kephalas hepta kai kerata deka kai epi tas kephalas autou hepta diadēmata,

paragraphs.text: And his tail draweth the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon standeth before the woman that is about to be delivered, that when she is delivered he may devour her child.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡ οὐρὰ αὐτοῦ σύρει τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀστέρων τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἔβαλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν. καὶ ὁ δράκων ἕστηκεν ἐνώπιον τῆς γυναικὸς τῆς μελλούσης τεκεῖν, ἵνα ὅταν τέκῃ τὸ τέκνον αὐτῆς καταφάγῃ.
paragraphs.translit: kai hē oura autou syrei to triton tōn asterōn tou ouranou, kai ebalen autous eis tēn gēn. kai ho drakōn hestēken enōpion tēs gynaikos tēs mellousēs tekein, hina hotan tekē to teknon autēs kataphagē.

paragraphs.text: And she was delivered of a son, a man child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and unto his throne.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱόν, ἄρσεν, ὃς μέλλει ποιμαίνειν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ· καὶ ἡρπάσθη τὸ τέκνον αὐτῆς πρὸς τὸν θεὸν καὶ πρὸς τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai eteken hyion, arsen, hos mellei poimainein panta ta ethnē en rhabdō sidēra· kai hērpasthē to teknon autēs pros ton theon kai pros ton thronon autou.

paragraphs.text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that there they may nourish her a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἔφυγεν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον, ὅπου ἔχει ἐκεῖ τόπον ἡτοιμασμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα ἐκεῖ τρέφωσιν αὐτὴν ἡμέρας χιλίας διακοσίας ἑξήκοντα.
paragraphs.translit: kai hē gynē ephygen eis tēn erēmon, hopou echei ekei topon hētoimasmenon apo tou theou, hina ekei trephōsin autēn hēmeras chilias diakosias hexēkonta.

paragraphs.text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels [going forth] to war with the dragon; and the dragon warred and his angels;
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο πόλεμος ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, ὁ Μιχαὴλ καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ τοῦ πολεμῆσαι μετὰ τοῦ δράκοντος. καὶ ὁ δράκων ἐπολέμησεν καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: Kai egeneto polemos en tō ouranō, ho Michaēl kai hoi angeloi autou tou polemēsai meta tou drakontos. kai ho drakōn epolemēsen kai hoi angeloi autou,

paragraphs.text: And they prevailed not, neither was their place found any more in heaven.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυσεν, οὐδὲ τόπος εὑρέθη αὐτῶν ἔτι ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ouk ischysen, oude topos heurethē autōn eti en tō ouranō.

paragraphs.text: And the great dragon was cast down, the old serpent, he that is called the Devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world; he was cast down to the earth, and his angels were cast down with him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐβλήθη ὁ δράκων ὁ μέγας, ὁ ὄφις ὁ ἀρχαῖος, ὁ καλούμενος Διάβολος καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς, ὁ πλανῶν τὴν οἰκουμένην ὅλην— ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν γῆν, καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτοῦ ἐβλήθησαν.
paragraphs.translit: kai eblēthē ho drakōn ho megas, ho ophis ho archaios, ho kaloumenos Diabolos kai ho Satanas, ho planōn tēn oikoumenēn holēn— eblēthē eis tēn gēn, kai hoi angeloi autou metʼ autou eblēthēsan.

paragraphs.text: And I heard a great voice in heaven, saying,     Now is come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, who accuseth them before our God day and night.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν μεγάλην ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ λέγουσαν· Ἄρτι ἐγένετο ἡ σωτηρία καὶ ἡ δύναμις καὶ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ ἐξουσία τοῦ χριστοῦ αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐβλήθη ὁ κατήγωρ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν, ὁ κατηγορῶν αὐτοὺς ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτός.
paragraphs.translit: Kai ēkousa phōnēn megalēn en tō ouranō legousan· Arti egeneto hē sōtēria kai hē dynamis kai hē basileia tou theou hēmōn kai hē exousia tou christou autou, hoti eblēthē ho katēgōr tōn adelphōn hēmōn, ho katēgorōn autous enōpion tou theou hēmōn hēmeras kai nyktos.

paragraphs.text: And they overcame him because of the blood of the Lamb, and because of the word of their testimony; and they loved not their life even unto death.
paragraphs.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐνίκησαν αὐτὸν διὰ τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ἀρνίου καὶ διὰ τὸν λόγον τῆς μαρτυρίας αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐκ ἠγάπησαν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτῶν ἄχρι θανάτου·
paragraphs.translit: kai autoi enikēsan auton dia to haima tou arniou kai dia ton logon tēs martyrias autōn, kai ouk ēgapēsan tēn psychēn autōn achri thanatou·

paragraphs.text: Therefore rejoice, O heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe for the earth and for the sea: because the devil is gone down unto you, having great wrath, knowing that he hath but a short time.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτο εὐφραίνεσθε, οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ οἱ ἐν αὐτοῖς σκηνοῦντες. οὐαὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν, ὅτι κατέβη ὁ διάβολος πρὸς ὑμᾶς, ἔχων θυμὸν μέγαν, εἰδὼς ὅτι ὀλίγον καιρὸν ἔχει.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto euphrainesthe, hoi ouranoi kai hoi en autois skēnountes. ouai tēn gēn kai tēn thalassan, hoti katebē ho diabolos pros hymas, echōn thymon megan, eidōs hoti oligon kairon echei.

paragraphs.text: And when the dragon saw that he was cast down to the earth, he persecuted the woman that brought forth the man [child].
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ὅτε εἶδεν ὁ δράκων ὅτι ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν γῆν, ἐδίωξεν τὴν γυναῖκα ἥτις ἔτεκεν τὸν ἄρσενα.
paragraphs.translit: Kai hote eiden ho drakōn hoti eblēthē eis tēn gēn, ediōxen tēn gynaika hētis eteken ton arsena.

paragraphs.text: And there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness unto her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐδόθησαν τῇ γυναικὶ αἱ δύο πτέρυγες τοῦ ἀετοῦ τοῦ μεγάλου, ἵνα πέτηται εἰς τὴν ἔρημον εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς, ὅπου τρέφεται ἐκεῖ καιρὸν καὶ καιροὺς καὶ ἥμισυ καιροῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ ὄφεως.
paragraphs.translit: kai edothēsan tē gynaiki hai dyo pteryges tou aetou tou megalou, hina petētai eis tēn erēmon eis ton topon autēs, hopou trephetai ekei kairon kai kairous kai hēmisy kairou apo prosōpou tou opheōs.

paragraphs.text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth after the woman water as a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔβαλεν ὁ ὄφις ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ὀπίσω τῆς γυναικὸς ὕδωρ ὡς ποταμόν, ἵνα αὐτὴν ποταμοφόρητον ποιήσῃ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ebalen ho ophis ek tou stomatos autou opisō tēs gynaikos hydōr hōs potamon, hina autēn potamophorēton poiēsē.

paragraphs.text: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐβοήθησεν ἡ γῆ τῇ γυναικί, καὶ ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς καὶ κατέπιεν τὸν ποταμὸν ὃν ἔβαλεν ὁ δράκων ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: kai eboēthēsen hē gē tē gynaiki, kai ēnoixen hē gē to stoma autēs kai katepien ton potamon hon ebalen ho drakōn ek tou stomatos autou·

paragraphs.text: And the dragon waxed wroth with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, that keep the commandments of God, and hold the testimony of Jesus:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὠργίσθη ὁ δράκων ἐπὶ τῇ γυναικί, καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ποιῆσαι πόλεμον μετὰ τῶν λοιπῶν τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῆς, τῶν τηρούντων τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐχόντων τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ· καὶ ἐστάθη ἐπὶ τὴν ἄμμον τῆς θαλάσσης.
paragraphs.translit: kai ōrgisthē ho drakōn epi tē gynaiki, kai apēlthen poiēsai polemon meta tōn loipōn tou spermatos autēs, tōn tērountōn tas entolas tou theou kai echontōn tēn martyrian Iēsou· kai estathē epi tēn ammon tēs thalassēs.
